description: List the ~211 national, regional, and EU-institution data catalogues (portal source ids, e.g. "gdi-de", "govdata", "geocat-li") that feed the EU Open Data Portal, optionally filtered by an id substring. Data: data.europa.eu Hub-Search API, no auth required.

query.description: Substring filter on catalogue id (e.g. "geo" matches "geocat-li", "gdi-de")

name: data-europa.reference.catalogue_list

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.
